'''B8-CT8''' was a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] that existed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It was found in the game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. The player can acquire it from redeeming a loot from Card Assault in-game.
